svg.text: GOODFEATURESTOTRACK ON THE PATCH: THE SMALLER-EIGENVALUE MAP AND THE ONE POINT IT RETURNS
the selection rule, on these numbers
1 maximum of the map: 616,156 at (r0, c1), (r4, c1)
(reflect-101 mirrors row r1's ring over r0 and r4)
2 zero everything at or below 0.01 × max = 6,162
3 keep pixels equal to their 3×3 maximum
4 scan rows and columns 1 to 3 only
why (r2, c2): two edges in one window
